reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the matching tolerance instead of recomputing 7.5% and its rounding.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass their operator, and schedule-template's own isbetween dispatch is removed.

placement.why: The planning-amount rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the ranged worst case already lives, and the tolerance comes from the rules module that owns it.

scope.why: Only the helper, the planning call sites passing the operator, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: One definition used by every planning path; inserting op before the inverse boolean changes the positional signature, which is safe here but a little fragile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning paths (forecast, schedule template, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview transactions, API expectedAmount, account balance) call getScheduledAmount with the operator.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the threshold is reused and the rule lives in one helper.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, now taking the operator, is the single definition used by forecast-schedules, schedule-template, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, api schedules-get and Balance.tsx.
